package decision

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain/repository"
)

// IDGenerator creates decision and event identifiers.
type IDGenerator interface {
	NewID() string
}

// Clock makes decision time deterministic.
type Clock interface {
	Now() time.Time
}

// RecordInput contains the explainable outcome selected by deterministic policies/orchestration.
type RecordInput struct {
	PersonalTeacherID string
	StudentID         string
	CorrelationID     string
	CausationID       string
	LearningActionID  string
	TeachingMode      domain.TeachingMode
	ContextType       domain.LearningContextType
	ContextID         string
	PedagogyMethod    string
	PedagogyVersion   string
	PedagogyStage     domain.PedagogyStage
	Strategy          string
	Action            domain.TeacherAction
	HintLevel         *int
	ReasonCode        string
	ReasonSummary     string
	PolicyVersion     string
}

// Record persists one TeacherDecision and its integration event atomically.
type Record struct {
	Decisions repository.TeacherDecision
	IDs       IDGenerator
	Clock     Clock
}

// Execute records an auditable business reason without chain-of-thought.
func (uc Record) Execute(ctx context.Context, input RecordInput) (domain.TeacherDecision, error) {
	if uc.Decisions == nil || uc.IDs == nil || uc.Clock == nil {
		return domain.TeacherDecision{}, errors.New("invalid record teacher decision use case")
	}
	now := uc.Clock.Now()
	decision, err := domain.NewTeacherDecision(domain.TeacherDecision{
		ID:                uc.IDs.NewID(),
		PersonalTeacherID: input.PersonalTeacherID,
		StudentID:         input.StudentID,
		CorrelationID:     input.CorrelationID,
		CausationID:       input.CausationID,
		LearningActionID:  input.LearningActionID,
		TeachingMode:      input.TeachingMode,
		ContextType:       input.ContextType,
		ContextID:         input.ContextID,
		PedagogyMethod:    input.PedagogyMethod,
		PedagogyVersion:   input.PedagogyVersion,
		PedagogyStage:     input.PedagogyStage,
		Strategy:          input.Strategy,
		Action:            input.Action,
		HintLevel:         input.HintLevel,
		ReasonCode:        input.ReasonCode,
		ReasonSummary:     input.ReasonSummary,
		PolicyVersion:     input.PolicyVersion,
		CreatedAt:         now,
	})
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherDecision{}, err
	}
	event, err := domain.NewIntegrationEvent(
		uc.IDs.NewID(),
		domain.SubjectTeacherDecisionRecorded,
		decision.CorrelationID,
		decision.CausationID,
		decision.StudentID,
		decision.CreatedAt,
		domain.TeacherDecisionRecordedSchemaVersion,
		decision,
	)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherDecision{}, err
	}
	if err := uc.Decisions.Record(ctx, decision, event); err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherDecision{}, err
	}
	return decision, nil
}
